title: Soup loop version change record
description: One line each time the active version changes, appended to .soup-loops/versions.jsonl (default layout). The active version is the to_version of the last line. The first deployed model is cause initial; a canary that becomes the main version is cause promote; going back to an earlier version, automatic or by a person, is cause rollback. Readers ignore unknown fields.

id.description: This line's own id, a UUID in canonical lowercase form.

ts.description: When the switch took effect, ISO 8601 UTC.

from_version.description: The version that was active before; null only for cause initial.

to_version.description: The version active from now on.

actor.description: loop: the automatic cycle decided (e.g. a canary regression). user: a person decided.

iteration_id.description: The iteration that produced to_version (promote) or whose canary was withdrawn (rollback).

served_as.description: The name to_version is served under: a soup serve adapter name, or an Ollama tag such as myproj:v1.

alias.description: The moving name that now points at to_version (e.g. the Ollama model myproj), if the producer keeps one.

source.description: Which program wrote the line (e.g. soup-loop, or the Soup Zero surface).

^x_[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$.description: Producer extension namespace (x_<app>). Soup never reads or rewrites it.
